user.title: Connect to the NVR
user.description: Enter the NVR that produces the intrusion alarm and the camera channels to watch. Use a comma separated list when several channels should trigger the light (for example 2,6). The credentials are stored by Home Assistant and only sent to the NVR.

camera.title: Connect to the light camera
camera.description: NVR {nvr_host}, alarm channels {trigger_channels}. Enter the PTZ/camera whose white light should be boosted, plus the night window and hold time.
